name: cron-schedule-lint
description: Names every schedule line in the file you have open that fires at the wrong hour, twice, or never at all - and prints the next three times each one really fires, in the zone that actually applies.

commands.title: Check this file for schedules that misfire
List the 29 rules that ship inside
Build the schedule calendar for the whole repository
Export the calendar as CSV, JSON or HTML
Write machine output for a CI gate

cron-schedule-lint.report_format.description: Format used when the calendar is exported (csv, json or html)

cron-schedule-lint.min_severity.description: Hide findings below this severity (info, warn or error)

cron-schedule-lint.max_files.description: Most files to open during a repository scan

cron-schedule-lint.exclude_glob.description: Paths skipped during a repository scan
